title: Present Continuous: Use
grammarNote:
Мы уже знаем КАК образовывать Present Continuous. Теперь самое важное — КОГДА его использовать. И чем он отличается от Present Simple, который мы изучили в Модуле 4.

📌 Четыре ситуации для Present Continuous:

① Действие происходит ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС, в момент речи:
"I am writing code." (сейчас, пока я это говорю)
"She is reading her notes." (прямо сейчас, в данный момент)

② Временная ситуация (не постоянная, не каждый день):
"Malika is studying in the library today." (только сегодня, обычно она в комнате)
"I am living in Uralsk this year." (временно — на время учёбы)

③ Ситуация меняется / в процессе изменения:
"My English is getting better every week!"
"The city is growing fast."

④ Запланированное будущее (уже договорились):
"I am meeting Sholpan at 3 pm." (договорились заранее)
"We are having dinner at 7 tonight." (план уже есть)

🔑 Слова-сигналы для Present Continuous:
now · right now · at the moment · at this moment · currently · today (в значении "сегодня происходит") · Look! · Listen!

grammarExtra.title: ⚠️ Stative Verbs — глаголы БЕЗ Present Continuous

rows.example:
like · love · hate · prefer · want · need · wish
❌ "I am wanting coffee." → ✅ "I want coffee."

know · understand · believe · remember · forget · think (= считать) · mean
❌ "She is knowing the answer." → ✅ "She knows the answer."

see · hear · smell · taste · feel (пассивно)
❌ "I am seeing the board." → ✅ "I can see the board."

have (= иметь/владеть) · own · belong · contain
❌ "She is having a laptop." → ✅ "She has a laptop."
"I'm having lunch." ✅ (действие: есть) vs "I have a laptop." ✅ (владеть)
"I'm thinking about the project." ✅ (думаю сейчас) vs "I think it's correct." ✅ (считаю/мнение)

grammarExtra.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — полное сравнение

rows.example: "Amir studies Computer Science." · "The library opens at 8 am."
"Amir is studying in the library." · "The library is closing in five minutes!"
"She reads books every evening." · "He eats lunch in the cafeteria every day."
"She is reading a Psychology book right now." · "He is eating porridge this morning."
"I know the answer." · "She likes coffee." · "He understands English well."
"I am writing the answer." · "She is making coffee." · "He is learning English."
"What are you doing?" — "I'm writing code." · "I'm reading my notes."
"What is the barista doing?" — "He's making a cappuccino."
"Why are you studying in the library today?" — "My internet isn't working at home."
"Who is sleeping near the window?" · "Who is arguing next to you?"
"Look — he is sleeping!" · "Listen — someone is printing something."

rows.form: Сигналы: now · right now · at the moment
rows.example: "She is reading RIGHT NOW." · "AT THE MOMENT, everyone is working." · "What is he doing NOW?"

grammarTip:
Как не перепутать Present Simple и Present Continuous:

① Спроси себя: это происходит ВСЕГДА или ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС?
   Всегда / обычно / каждый день → Present Simple
   "Amir studies every day." · "She reads in the evenings."

   Прямо сейчас / временно / в данный момент → Present Continuous
   "Amir is studying right now." · "She is reading at the moment."

② Найди слово-сигнал:
   every day / usually / always / never → Simple ✅
   now / right now / at the moment / look! / listen! → Continuous ✅

③ Проверь: это stative verb?
   know / like / love / want / understand / have (владеть) → ТОЛЬКО Simple!
   ❌ "I am knowing." ❌ "She is wanting." ❌ "He is having a car."
   ✅ "I know." ✅ "She wants." ✅ "He has a car."

💡 Тест: можно ли сказать "прямо сейчас я это [делаю/чувствую/думаю]"?
   Если это действие — Continuous. Если состояние — Simple.
   "I am writing." ✅ (действие) · "I know." ✅ (состояние — нельзя "knowing"!)

exercises.text: Malika usually ___ in her room, but today she ___ in the library.
exercises.hint: usually → Present Simple (studies). today (temporarily) → Present Continuous (is studying).

exercises.text: "I am knowing the answer to this question." is correct English.
exercises.hint: "Know" is a stative verb (состояние ума). It NEVER takes -ing! → "I know the answer." ✅

exercises.text: Which sentence uses Present Continuous correctly?
opts: She is wanting another coffee right now.
Look — the professor is writing on the whiteboard!
I am knowing all the spelling rules.
exercises.correct: Look — the professor is writing on the whiteboard!
exercises.hint: "Look!" is a signal word → Continuous. "write" is an action verb → writing ✅. The others use stative verbs (want, understand, know) which cannot take -ing.

exercises.instruction: Choose: Simple or Continuous?  Write the correct form.
exercises.text: Listen! Someone ___ (print) a very long document in the library.
exercises.hint: "Listen!" is a signal for Present Continuous → is printing ✅.

exercises.text: Amir ___ Computer Science at WKU. It is his course.
exercises.hint: This is a permanent fact about Amir — his course. Use Present Simple: "He studies Computer Science." (not a temporary action).

exercises.text: "I'm having lunch with Sholpan right now" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "have lunch" = to eat lunch. This is an ACTION (not possession) → Continuous IS allowed! "I'm having lunch" = "I'm eating lunch." ✅

exercises.text: "Why are you in the library today, Malika?" — ___
opts: Because I am not usually study here.
Because my internet isn't working at home today.
Because I am wanting to read.
exercises.correct: Because my internet isn't working at home today.
exercises.hint: "isn't working" = Present Continuous → a temporary situation. The other options have grammar mistakes.

exercises.text: Which pair of sentences is completely correct?
opts: She is liking coffee. She drinks a cup every morning.
She likes coffee. She is drinking a cup right now.
She likes coffee. She is drink a cup right now.
She is liking coffee. She is drinking a cup right now.
exercises.correct: She likes coffee. She is drinking a cup right now.
exercises.hint: "like" = stative → Simple: "She likes." ✅ · "drink" right now = action → Continuous: "She is drinking." ✅
